name: Offer {OS}

group.label: 04 · GROW
group.purpose: Turn value into distribution and revenue

tagline: The thing you sell, shaped so the value is obvious.

commands.name: /offer
commands.does: Opens the OS and reports the state of every offer
commands.returns: the offer set with lifecycle state per offer

commands.name: /offer-draft
commands.does: Drafts a candidate offer from the claim and the job to be done

commands.name: /offer-scope
commands.does: Draws the scope boundary and gives each deliverable an acceptance form

commands.name: /offer-exclude
commands.does: States what the offer deliberately does not cover

commands.name: /offer-deliverables
commands.does: Enumerates the deliverables and their acceptance conditions
commands.returns: the deliverable list with acceptance forms

commands.name: /offer-guarantee
commands.does: Designs a guarantee and models its worst case cost
commands.returns: a guarantee record with a cost ceiling

commands.name: /offer-proof
commands.does: Assembles the proof set behind each promise
commands.returns: proof items, each with a source

commands.name: /offer-cost-check
commands.does: Reconciles the offer against what fulfilment actually costs
commands.returns: a viable or not viable verdict with the gap named

commands.name: /offer-stress-test
commands.does: Runs the offer against real objections
commands.returns: an objection log and the revisions it forces

commands.name: /offer-review
commands.does: Audits the live offer set for contradiction and drift
commands.returns: findings, each with the contradicting statement quoted

commands.name: /offer-publish
commands.does: Publishes a versioned offer after human approval
commands.returns: a live, versioned offer emitted to consuming units

commands.name: /offer-retire
commands.does: Retires an offer and migrates the customers on it
commands.returns: a retirement record and a per customer migration path

handoffs.artifact: the claim the offer must honour
what fulfilment actually costs to deliver

requires_human_approval_for: publishing an offer or any change to a live offer definition
adding, changing or removing a guarantee
retiring an offer that has live customers, including the migration path
widening the scope boundary or removing an exclusion
asserting a proof item that names a customer
the exact wording of any customer-facing offer text
